title: 3,716 Grams and $228,000 Cash: Inside the Earl Thomas Case

lines.say: Three thousand seven hundred sixteen grams of cocaine. Found in the home of the man who used Earl Thomas's identity.
lines.show: 3,716 grams of cocaine. Found in the home of the man who used Earl Thomas's identity.
